title: Sweep
description: A green phosphor radar screen whose beam finds herb's most played songs, the closest contacts being the most played. Each echo pings at a pitch set by its range and leaves a fading afterglow; tap one to lock on and the beam narrows to it while the readout types out.
intent: A PPI radar as a way to browse top songs: rank becomes range, every contact is painted only when the beam crosses it, and a float persistence buffer holds three phosphor decays (beam wake, long blip afterglow, short clutter) so the trails are real accumulation, not drawn fades.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (green CRT phosphor)
